mapper.update: UPDATE ORDER_ITEM SET STATUS = 'CANCEL_REQUEST' WHERE ORDER_ITEM_NO = #{orderItemNo} AND STATUS IN ('ORDERED', 'PAID', 'PREPARING')
mapper.select: SELECT CR.CANCEL_NO, CR.ORDER_ITEM_NO, CR.ORDER_NO, CR.MEMBER_NO, OI.BUSINESS_NO, OI.PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, OI.PRODUCT_PRICE, OI.QUANTITY, CR.REFUND_AMOUNT AS CANCEL_AMOUNT, CR.REASON, CR.STATUS, CR.CREATED_AT, CR.PROCESSED_AT, CR.REJECT_REASON, CR.CANCEL_TYPE, CR.CANCEL_GROUP_NO, CR.REFUND_AMOUNT, 1 AS ITEM_COUNT FROM CANCEL_REQUEST CR JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO = CR.ORDER_ITEM_NO JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = OI.PRODUCT_NO WHERE CR.CANCEL_NO = #{cancelNo} AND OI.BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE CANCEL_REQUEST SET STATUS = 'APPROVED', PROCESSED_AT = SYSDATE, REJECT_REASON = NULL WHERE CANCEL_NO = #{cancelNo} AND STATUS = 'WAITING'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CANCEL_REQUEST WHERE CANCEL_GROUP_NO = #{cancelGroupNo} AND STATUS = 'REJECTED'

SELECT CR.CANCEL_NO, CR.ORDER_ITEM_NO, CR.ORDER_NO, CR.MEMBER_NO, OI.BUSINESS_NO, OI.PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, OI.PRODUCT_PRICE, OI.QUANTITY, CR.REFUND_AMOUNT AS CANCEL_AMOUNT, CR.REASON, CR.STATUS, CR.CREATED_AT, CR.PROCESSED_AT, CR.REJECT_REASON, CR.CANCEL_TYPE, CR.CANCEL_GROUP_NO, CR.REFUND_AMOUNT, 1 AS ITEM_COUNT FROM CANCEL_REQUEST CR JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO = CR.ORDER_ITEM_NO JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = OI.PRODUCT_NO WHERE CR.CANCEL_GROUP_NO = #{cancelGroupNo} ORDER BY CR.CANCEL_NO
mapper.update: UPDATE ORDER_ITEM SET STATUS = 'PAID' WHERE ORDER_ITEM_NO = #{orderItemNo} AND STATUS = 'CANCEL_REQUEST'

UPDATE ORDER_ITEM OI SET OI.STATUS = 'PAID' WHERE OI.STATUS = 'CANCEL_REQUEST' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CANCEL_REQUEST CR WHERE CR.ORDER_ITEM_NO = OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO AND CR.CANCEL_GROUP_NO = #{cancelGroupNo} )
UPDATE ORDER_ITEM SET STATUS = 'CANCELED' WHERE ORDER_ITEM_NO = #{orderItemNo} AND STATUS = 'CANCEL_REQUEST'

UPDATE ORDER_ITEM OI SET OI.STATUS = 'CANCELED' WHERE OI.STATUS = 'CANCEL_REQUEST' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CANCEL_REQUEST CR WHERE CR.ORDER_ITEM_NO = OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO AND CR.CANCEL_GROUP_NO = #{cancelGroupNo} )
UPDATE PRODUCT SET STOCK = STOCK + #{quantity} WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo}

UPDATE ORDERS O SET O.ORDER_STATUS = ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = SUM(CASE WHEN OI.STATUS = 'CANCELED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'CANCELED' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN OI.STATUS = 'CANCEL_REQUEST' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'CANCEL_REQUEST' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN OI.STATUS = 'CANCELED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'PARTIAL_CANCELED' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN OI.STATUS = 'SHIPPING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'SHIPPING' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN OI.STATUS = 'PREPARING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'PREPARING' ELSE 'PAID' END FROM ORDER_ITEM OI WHERE OI.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo} ) WHERE O.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo}
